phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, the opponent has a heavy economy and technology, with a ground army including Marines. Your own army composition is still unknown.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's build or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, scout for opponent's plan, maintain defensive readiness.
phase_policies.target: Focus on expanding your economy and technology, while scouting to determine the opponent's intentions.
phase_policies.title: Economy and Technology Focus with Scouting
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a specific army composition without scouting information; avoid neglecting defensive readiness while focusing on economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 300 seconds, both players have a heavy economy and technology investment, with a ground-oriented army. The opponent shows possible pressure with Reapers and Hellions.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's composition or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech, strengthen ground army, maintain defense against possible pressure.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing your economy and technology, strengthen your ground army, and maintain defensive readiness.
phase_policies.title: Ground Development with Defensive Readiness
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-extend or attack into a fortified position; avoid neglecting defensive readiness while focusing on economy and technology.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 540 seconds, both players have transitioned to a midgame ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, and supporting units. The opponent shows moderate air presence.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's tech choices or when you are ready to push.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Add air units for defense, continue ground strength, maintain economy.
phase_policies.target: Increase your air presence to counter potential drops or air threats, continue strengthening your ground army, and maintain your economy.
phase_policies.title: Siege Tank Transition with Air Flexibility
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground forces without adding air units; avoid neglecting economy while transitioning.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, both players have a heavy ground army with Siege Tanks and Marines, and a moderate air presence. The opponent has a heavy defense.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you have more information about the opponent's tech or when you are ready to take a decisive fight.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, increase air, maintain economy for sustained fight.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening your ground army, increase your air presence, and maintain your economy to support a long fight.
phase_policies.title: Sustained Pressure with Air and Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground forces and neglect air upgrades or economy; avoid resource exhaustion in a prolonged engagement.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
